title: Persist Slide Modifications Across Navigation
description: Specs changed: all slides remember their modifications (drag/resize, enlarge, selection). Modifications reset only when reset buttons are pressed, not on slide navigation. Remove slideEpoch reset effect from usePresentationInteraction; clearSelection clears only selection not enlarge; add tests.
summary: Per-slide modifications (drag/resize transforms, enlarge, selection) now persist across reveal.js navigation. Removed slideEpoch wipe from usePresentationInteraction; clearSelection clears only selection so enlarge survives empty-click deselect. Reset buttons remain the explicit way to clear modifications. Added tests for navigation persistence and enlarge-after-deselect. All 95 renderer tests pass.
